name: @w6w-apps/holded
description: Manage Holded CRM funnels, leads and calendar events through the Holded CRM API.

w6w.longDescription:
Holded is a Spanish business-management SaaS combining invoicing, accounting, projects, team and CRM in one product. This app covers Holded's CRM API: sales funnels (the customizable pipelines a business defines its own stages for), leads (opportunities placed in a funnel stage, with notes, tasks and a creation date a workflow can adjust), and calendar events (meetings and reminders that can be tied to a lead or a contact).

Good for pushing a new website or form lead straight into a Holded funnel, updating a lead's stage as a deal progresses, logging a call or meeting as a lead note or task, and scheduling follow-up events without leaving the workflow that generated the lead.

Holded's invoicing, accounting, projects and team APIs are separate API groups on the same host and are out of scope here — this app only reaches `/api/crm/v1`.
